display.purpose: The hero headline only; 36px at 390, 64px at 1440. Han: tracking 0, leading 1.25.

heading.purpose: Section titles, capped at 36px. Han: tracking 0, leading 1.45.

section.purpose: Column titles and privacy subheads. Han: tracking 0, leading 1.45.

lede.purpose: The one sub line under the headline, 18px to 20px at md, muted ink.

body.purpose: Paragraphs; 16px, 17px from 48rem; muted ink after a heading.

quiet.purpose: Captions, copyright, nav and footer links (500), fact row, privacy note. Han: leading 1.7.

label.purpose: Table column headers, sentence case, never uppercase.

fonts.name: Inter
fonts.note: Latin only; no weight array (variable). font-optical-sizing: auto on html.

fonts.name: Han device stack
fonts.value: "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Source Han Sans SC", "Noto Sans SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif
fonts.note: Declared in globals.css and drawn by the device. No CJK webfont is fetched.

shadows.name: device-drop
shadows.purpose: The phone frame inside the product panel only. No other shadow exists.

motion.name: rise-stagger
motion.purpose: Headline, sub, buttons, facts, product panel; the page assembles top-down and ends on the product.

motion.name: hover-color
motion.purpose: Ghost button, nav and footer links, underline decoration.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.value: scroll-behavior: smooth under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference only

motion.name: ease-rise
motion.purpose: Every event: entrances, quote arrivals, a cell becoming the answer. Events rise.

motion.name: ease-drift
motion.purpose: The two ambient loops only — the capture's pan and the glow's breath. Continuous motion drifts.

motion.name: quotes-cycle
motion.value: 4 moves, one every 4000ms, 16s a cycle, starting 2220ms after mount
motion.purpose: The living Quotes sheet: a supplier re-quotes, the row's lowest recounts, the Bid follows. quote-arrive / quote-choose / tick-draw with no stagger; components/quotes-sheet.tsx.

motion.name: capture-pan
motion.value: translateY(0 -> -2rem), 16s ease-drift infinite alternate, 10% held at each end
motion.purpose: The phone capture panning inside its fixed-height frame, as if somebody were idly scrolling it.

motion.name: glow-drift
motion.value: translateX(-2% -> 2%) with opacity 0.8 -> 1, 18s ease-drift infinite alternate
motion.purpose: The light behind the product panel breathing; barely perceptible under a stare.

motion.name: stage-still
motion.purpose: components/ambient-stage.tsx marks the panel still when it is off screen or the tab is hidden; the sheet's cycle clears its timer on the same two conditions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation-duration 0.01ms, animation-delay 0ms, transition-duration 0.01ms, !important, on *; animation: none on the two loops
motion.purpose: Collapses every finite gesture onto its end state and removes the loops outright; the sheet's clock never starts.

theme.mechanism: The site is light only: color-scheme: light on :root and every colour stated once as a plain value; no theme class, no toggle, no dark: variants.
theme.preview: Nothing to preview: there is one reading, and no theme attribute or class the site or a reviewer can set.

constraints: No CJK webfont may be fetched; Han is the device stack.
:lang(zh-Hans) overrides (tracking 0, open leading, no uppercase) must survive any redesign.
ADR-0035: no price, no signup link, only https://app.awardley.com/login, waiting list only, nothing stored before confirm.
The 390px layout suite must pass in both locales; every rendered component is sync.
The site is light only; there is no dark reading and no theme switch.

narrative.overview:
The landing at awardley.com is a conventional product site at full craft, with Linear and Stripe as the bar. It is a separate world from the app (which keeps Fira and warm paper under ADR-0019); it shares only the name and the three-bar mark. The page is one ground and one accent: every section is told apart by a hairline rather than by a change of colour, so the only saturated thing above the fold is the primary button, and the indigo appears exactly three more times (the glow behind the product panel, the selected Quotes in the example sheet, the focus ring). Proof is shown as real UI, a phone capture cropped by its frame beside an HTML Quotes sheet labelled "Example data", never as logos, counts or testimonials.

Density is generous and quiet: a max-w-6xl measure, 40px landmarks (72px on desktop), four type tiers and no eyebrow. The site is light only: every colour is stated once, as a plain value on :root, and color-scheme: light keeps the browser's own canvas and controls light on a dark device. There is no dark reading, no toggle and no theme attribute on <html>. Both scripts are first-class: Inter is fetched for Latin only, Han is drawn by the device, and :lang(zh-Hans) trades tracking for leading at every tier.

Confirmed anti-references: the app's Fira + warm-paper brochure (4238188) and the slate-and-navy Trust page with three icon cards in Plus Jakarta Sans (041851c). Neither is to be quoted.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome ground, one indigo accent, no second ground or coloured band anywhere.
Sections divided by 8% hairlines; controls edged by a separate, darker input token.
Inter (variable, opsz) with tight negative tracking on Latin display; zero tracking and open leading under :lang(zh-Hans).
Four type tiers (display, heading, section, quiet), all headings at 600, none heavier.

Two easings and two kinds of motion — events rise (--ease-rise), continuous motion drifts (--ease-drift); one entrance and one focal sequence, then three ambient loops inside the product panel, paused off screen and gone under reduced motion.
Corner says what a thing is: 8px operated, 12px replies, 16px containers.

rules.name: The One Ground Rule
rules.body: There is one page ground and one alternate a step off it. No section, header or call to action changes the ground colour; sections are separated by hairlines.

rules.name: The Once-Spent Accent Rule
rules.body: Indigo is spent on the primary button and appears again only as the panel glow, the selected-quote wash and tick, and the focus ring. It is never a stripe, band, eyebrow or decorative rule.

rules.name: The Two Edges Rule
rules.body: border (8%) is for rules and frames and may sit below 3:1; anything the reader operates is edged with input, which clears 3:1.

rules.name: The One Declaration Rule
rules.body: The site is light only, and every colour is stated exactly once on :root. No dark reading, no dark: variants, no second token block, no toggle and no theme attribute on <html>; color-scheme: light tells the browser the same thing about its own canvas and controls.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Four tiers and nothing over a heading. A kicker above a headline is a heading that did not trust itself.

rules.name: The Han Leading Rule
rules.body: Under :lang(zh-Hans) every tier sets letter-spacing: 0 and opens leading (1.25 display, 1.45 heading and section, 1.7 quiet). There is no uppercase anywhere on the site, so nothing needs suppressing.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any table of amounts is tabular-nums, one currency, grouped by three and two-placed, written out rather than left to toLocaleString.

rules.name: The Six Hundred Rule
rules.body: Headings and the wordmark are 600; 700 does not appear. The display line is bigger than the wordmark, not heavier.

rules.name: The Hairline Depth Rule
rules.body: Layers are declared by a hairline and a one-step ground change. Shadows do not mark elevation; the single shadow on the site is a photographic device drop, not a UI elevation.

rules.name: The Two Curves Rule
rules.body: Events rise and continuous motion drifts. --ease-rise (a hard ease-out) carries anything that happens once because something happened; --ease-drift (symmetric) is spent only on the ambient loops, which have no start or end to ease out of. There is no third easing.

dos: Do state every colour once, as a plain value on :root, and declare color-scheme: light alongside them.
Do separate sections and columns with the 8% hairline and keep the page on one ground.
Do edge anything operable with input, the darker control edge, and leave border for rules and frames.
Do keep every control at 44px (the tap floor); the 36px bar button is the one exception and it defers to the 44px primary while that is on screen.
Do set headings at 600 and let size, tracking and leading carry hierarchy; cap section headings at 36px.
Do keep :lang(zh-Hans) at zero tracking with open leading at every tier, and draw Han from the device stack.
Do use tabular-nums, one currency and hand-formatted grouping in any table of amounts.
Do label example data on its face, and show the product as real UI (the phone capture, an HTML sheet).
Do name spacing by what it separates: label 8, field 14, group 24, landmark 40 (72 on desktop).
donts: Don't fetch a CJK webfont; Inter is Latin-only and Han is the device's.
Don't add a theme toggle, a dark reading, a dark: variant, a theme attribute on <html>, or a second token block.
Don't introduce a coloured band, stripe, second ground, eyebrow, kicker, numbered step or icon-over-column card.
Don't put a price, a signup link, logos, counts or testimonials on the page (ADR-0035; the only app link is /login, the only ask is the waiting list).
Don't use a weight above 600, uppercase labels, or negative tracking on Han.
Don't add shadows to buttons, inputs or panels; the one shadow is the phone's device drop.
Don't animate anything outside the hero's entrance, the sheet's sequence and the product panel's ambient loops, and don't leave motion running under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
Don't add a second icon; the tick is the whole icon vocabulary, inline and currentColor.

Don't loop anything but ambient motion inside the product panel, and never loop anything the reader has to read: a loop is allowed only if it is slow, quiet, paused off screen and in a hidden tab, and removed outright under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
